name: apprua
description: Publish and manage the apps you build with AI on your own {{BRAND}} server.
long_description: {{BRAND}} lets your AI app publish a local folder as a web app on your own server (or your own PC), publish new versions, read logs, set secrets and manage your apps. Open source (AGPL-3.0).

token.title: Personal token
token.description: Create it in the {{BRAND}} portal. It expires on its own.
